pages.text: Storage Stabilizers increase the storage space in the storage dimension of the storage actuator.$(br) The higher the tier of the stabilizer, the more additional storage it provides.$(br) The following entries will show you how to craft $()

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: The stabilizer system works by tier, starting from 0 (which does not add space) up to 5.$(br2)To get started, see the recipes and instructions on the following pages.$(br)

pages.title: Upgrading
pages.text: It is $(bold)safe to destroy a storage stabilizer$() to upgrade it. The items$(br) in the $(l:storage/storage_controller)Storage Actuator$(/l) will not be lost or dropped - you simply cannot add new items$(br) until you add enough storage stabilizers to have free slots again.$(br)

pages.title: Build Instructions
pages.text: Storage controllers need to point at the $(l:crafting_rituals/craft_dimensional_matrix)Dimensional Matrix$(/l), that means $(bold)one block above the $(l:storage/storage_controller)Storage Actuator$(/l)$().$(br2) $(br) They can be $(bold)up to 5 blocks away$() from the Dimensional Matrix, and need to be in$()

pages.title: Build Instructions
pages.text: $(br) a straight line of sight. See the next page for a possible very simple setup.$(br)
$(bold)Note:$() You do not need all 4 stabilizers, even one will increase your storage.$(br) In addition, the up and down directions also work.$(br)
